T1 human sign-off — feature story for multi-turn-conversation. The requirement set is complete and locked: 20 functional requirements (FR-MTC-001..020) — the one-deep dialogue frame (DialogueManager + DialogueFrame) with both probe kinds (.slotFill for a missing slot, e.g. the bhajan deity; .candidateChoice/didYouMean: an honest 'didn't understand' line plus voice-pickable candidates by name/index-word/repetition/free-form with the 'no — let me say it again' escape), template probes ne/en (never model-generated), pre-ladder answer interception with cancel words / emergency precedence / strong-new-command barge-in, deterministic answer merge, the curated on-device music option catalog, max 2 probes then execute with defaults, the 45 s deadline, and the degraded-brain deterministic path. Phase 1 (FR-MTC-001..017, all MUST) is the deterministic MVP, shippable alone — the owner's bhajan example ('play bhajans' -> which kind? -> 'dasain durga bhajans' -> correct playback) is its acceptance anchor (FR-MTC-003). Phase 2 (FR-MTC-018, v17 follow-up NLU fine-tune, pending OD-M3) and Phase 3 (FR-MTC-019 reminder/calendar rollover + FR-MTC-020 DV-* device-validation gate, pending OD-M4) are traceable but later phases. 12 non-functional requirements (NFR-MTC-001..012: probe budget, 45 s deadline, 1024-token ceiling with ~300-token clause headroom, zero new egress/network, log-safety gate (check-release-log-safety.sh), degraded-brain safety unchanged, ne/en localisation, 6 GB sustained multi-turn without jetsam). 97 Gherkin acceptance scenarios. The owner is asked to approve the feature story before design work begins: confirm the Phase 1 scope and that OD-M1..M4 remain OPEN into design with the study's recommendations as the defaults — OD-M1 probe policy (2 probes max, default offered on the first probe), OD-M2 option source (curated on-device catalog for the MVP), OD-M3 sequencing (Phase 1 first, v17 data authoring in parallel), OD-M4 Phase-3 scope (whether reminder/calendar answer capture rides this release) — with the owner re-confirming the dispositions at the final T2 sign-off. Supersession note: the greenfield brief's open-ended-conversation FR-008 is explicitly NOT delivered by this feature (bounded one-deep frames only) and is recorded as out of scope.
